cast.name: 扎哈利·巴哈罗夫 Zachary Baharov

director.name: 安东尼奥·皮苏 Antonio Pisu

introduction: The beloved three young Italian youth who enchanted worldwide audiences in their breakout movie, picking up a Golden Globe on the way, hit the road again. This time they accompany their friend to Sofia to put the moves on his recent love interest. Wouldn't you know they have no idea of the danger they are in. They end up caught between the Bulgarian mafia and the Italian security services with danger and pitfalls they could not have imagined. As one might expect, they set into motion a series of misunderstandings, to say the least. Unlikely coincidences make the three friends appear to be international spies. The three adventurers not only make important discoveries about themselves and the world at large, but they also come to understand the true worth of their friendship forged by this most terrifying mission. With Zachary Baharov who starred in films by Peter Weir, George Clooney, Tom Cruise and in Game Of Thrones.
